policy: No new product features during closure. Changes repair known failures. Any changed criterion requires an explicit revision, never silently relax a failed gate.

criteria.requirement: All source matters and lawyers reconciled one-to-one, including irregular numbering, complete legal names and source spans.
Publication permission propagates by entity and aliases. Explicit confidentiality wins. Unknown permission is confirmed before reasoning, never inferred as public.
Amounts retain currency, approximation and economic meaning. Exposure, project value and outcome are distinct. No invented FX conversions.
Every inclusion, reserve and exclusion rests on the source legal work, not client industry, amount or keyword guesses.
Canonical selection, global hero, order, identities, outcomes and classifications agree across source register, Audit and Submission.
Individual roles and work attribution match source or saved confirmation. Current rank, requested target and proposed category remain distinct; no firm rank transfers to a lawyer.
No unsupported authority, geography, transaction/litigation conversion, outcome, achievement or foreign-practice contamination.
Read both actual Word artifacts before approval; reject truncation, empty substantive sections, template instructions, confidential leakage or factual divergence.

External official table, own profile, detected individual profiles and adjacent competitor profiles retrieved where available with scope, source hash, date and attribution. Historical movement requires observed historical evidence; missing pages are explicit limitations.
Source-backed B9 candidacies, B10 within applicable limit and substantive C2 implement the strategy. Matter outcomes and distinctive contribution survive rewriting.
Submission speaks for the firm. No source-auditor commentary, unsupported superlatives or invented superiority. Audit evaluates evidence and recommends.

Audit is an executive 3–5 page letter with verdict, ordered portfolio, individual strategy, meaningful reserves/exclusions and genuine actions. No intermediate contradictions, invented scores or uncalculated zeros.
System failures are handled by RankPilot, never questions asking users to fix generated punctuation or technical errors. Real missing facts have a direct save/return path.
Persist trace of applicable graph nodes, scoped RAG sources, provider calls, stage reuse and bounded repairs. Unaffected text and source inputs survive repairs.
Borderline selected and reserve matters are compared on incremental evidentiary contribution. Professional preferences about final order remain distinguishable from factual errors.

preferences_not_gates: Exact paragraph count when complete organic prose is readable
A particular adjective or synonym absent unsupported claims
A preferred hero or tail order when a factual comparative rationale supports the alternative
exit: All material, acceptance and operational criteria pass for applicable cases; no known unresolved material defect; all adversarial checks detect intended failures without rejecting supported counterexamples. Missing source or unavailable mandatory verification means incomplete, not pass. Deliver a candidate for professional acceptance, not an assurance for all unseen cases.
